briefTitle: KO-2806 Monotherapy and Combination Therapies in Advanced Solid Tumors

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Arm #1 (KO-2806 monotherapy): Patients who have progressed on, or are refractory to, standard of care (SOC) treatments with advanced solid tumors, specifically: HRAS-mutant and/or amplified tumors (any solid tumor type); HRAS overexpression (only for HNSCC tumors); KRAS and/or NRAS, and/or HRAS-mutant and/or amplified NSCLC or CRC; KRAS-mutant and/or amplified PDAC...
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Eligibility rules are split across multiple different study arms with distinct mutation, prior line, and combination requirements that cannot be captured in a single typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Measurable disease by Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) v1.1.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Karnofsky Performance Status of 70 or higher with no clinically significant deterioration over the previous 2 weeks.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Karnofsky Performance Status is not an allowed typed check (only ECOG is allowed).

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Spinal cord compression, leptomeningeal disease, or clinically active CNS metastases.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Clinically active CNS metastases is a subjective or undefined condition rather than a clean typed brain_mets rule.
